registration.precision: FP32 checkpoint weights with BF16 autocast for GPU; FP32 CPU feature baseline
registration.scope: Warm standalone model forward, concurrency1, inputs already device-resident. Includes vocabulary projection for full-token head and selected-token projection for restricted head. Class emission needs one prefill and argmax; no autoregressive rationale or extra token decode. Excludes network, caches, retrieval, tokenization and queueing.
